notes.title: Deluxe Version Out, and NOV 16 Update Notes!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We are glad to have some good news to share!

[h2][b]Deluxe Version Out Now[/b][/h2]
Besides a copy of Concealed, the Deluxe Version contains the game's [b]Artbook[/b] and [b]Original Soundtrack[/b]. Purchase it now to enjoy a 10% discount.

P.S. In the OST, 2 pieces of music (Thread of Fate / Shallow Valley) created by Akira Yamaoka are not included for now because of copyright issues in Japan, but they will be added in the near future. We are sorry for the inconvenience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42512159/2726121286a638e8cd93b11f1de94ebe63533481.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]NOV 16 Update[/b][/h2]

1. Optimized controller operations, and added keyboard/controller guides. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42512159/b8408bc9a323fc4469251b3f82d3c48d282c83e7.jpg[/img]

2. Optimized saving function. Players can save the last sentence, and saving slots improve to 12.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42512159/bc44394650a8a1df4c755396e6c27253db3e9902.jpg[/img]

3. Added the function that speed up can skip the already read part. Click the speed up button in the left bottom corner to get 3X speed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42512159/54a0f5081a44235c80b02045ee91cd7e969466fc.jpg[/img]

4. Added support for Linux. Steam Deck can also support Concealed now without any obvious issues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42512159/44bab38506e4379be49703d79499095012507266.jpg[/img]

5.After the first playthrough, players can freely choose which chapter or day to play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42512159/fec33ff5bbc7d7236868fddd9893f2bad1b63b6e.jpg[/img]

6. Optimized some text issues.

notes.title: Concealed is Out Now!
notes.content:
[h2]It’s finally time! Concealed, our horror visual novel game, is out right now![/h2]

The game launches with 10% off, pricing at 12.99 USD. We appreciate your support and hope you enjoy the fantastic world of Concealed.

[h2][b]Crossover[/b][/h2]
Concealed is a part of comic series "Parallel", and now it has an in-game crossover with its predecessor, Ghost in the Pool. We also provide a bundle of these 2 games. If you already have Ghost in the Pool, you will enjoy an extra 10% off to buy Concealed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42512159/af1216d639265fb0abaa1a52bd17591fa02351bf.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Music by Masters[/b][/h2]
We are honored to have AKIRA YAMAOKA as our game's music composer, who created amazing OP and ED for our game, and Ami Nakazato who shared her wonderful singing. We hope through the premium music production, players could enjoy an unique music experience from the game. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42512159/87704d38fd753f5ff6ea359b0efc086377a2af9f.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Features[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Distinctive art in traditional white-black comic style, with image terror and psychological terror.
[*] Abundant plots with 7 chapters, over 300k words, and 20+ hours gameplay time.
[*] Multiple endings led by players' choices
[*] Diverse gameplay, 20+ characters, dozens of scenarios, and lots of choices.
[*] Crossover with Ghost in the Pool. Ya Ru will appear again.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42512159/4789d05e825fb004d4c8f448af2c150effbafeb2.jpg[/img]

Concealed will launch with Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and English. We are also considering Korean and Japanese, and will do our best to plan the localization.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42512159/16ce71c6838934a9bf79606907e068b910832ec3.jpg[/img]
We cannot wait any longer to let you enjoy the game. Don't forget to wishlist!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42512159/330eafb6f99535b63cb8d5936245eafc97f15c08.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Release Date Announced! See you on NOV 8!
notes.content:
Mark your calendars! Concealed, horror visual novel game, is coming out on November 8th!
The game launches with 10% off, pricing at 12.99 USD. We appreciate your support and hope you enjoy the fantastic world of Concealed.

Concealed is adapted from the comic series "Parallel", and will have a crossover with its predecessor, Ghost in the Pool.

https://youtu.be/xoPYtDSkoEg

With missing girls, unsolved cases, and bizarre urban tales circulating in the school for years, the truth is to be illuminated. Will you be the one to sovle the mtsteries?

[list]
[*] Distinctive art in traditional white-black comic style, with image terror and psychological terror.
[*] Abundant plots with 7 chapters, over 300k words, and 20+ hours gameplay time.
[*] Multiple endings led by players' choices
[*] Diverse gameplay, 20+ characters, dozens of scenarios, and lots of choices.
